View Toggle Buttons Map | Network | Links
GEO MAP (Leaflet) --- Tile Layers (Dark, Satellite, Topo) Marker Clusters Route Polylines (SNR colored) Precision Circles Node Popups (telemetry charts) animateSinglePacket()
LOGICAL NETWORK (D3) --- Force Simulation Nodes (circle, sized by traffic) Links (colored by SNR) Drag interaction Path highlight (click 2 nodes) triggerD3Packet()
TERMINAL TIMELINE --- Chronological packet replay Speed control slider Node and port filters Color-coded by packet type Triggers packet animations on both Geo and D3 maps pulseLeaflet() / pulseD3()
SIDEBAR --- Longest Links table Hop Statistics Unmapped Nodes list
AMBIENT PACKET FLOW LOOP --- setInterval(300ms) Pick random routePath Geo: animateSinglePacket(cyan) D3: triggerD3Packet(cyan) Respects speed control Continuous loop cycle
Offline: Disable share btn Show offline banner Force dark map tiles Queue sync to IDB
Online: Check syncQueue in IDB POST /api/cache pending Clear syncQueue
SETTINGS AND TOUR --- D3 Spread slider Speed control Theme toggle Tutorial overlay Export/share
SHARE FLOW --- 1. copyShareLink() 2. Build URL ?map=ID 3. Copy to clipboard 4. Toast confirmation
GET /api/data?id= --- Lookup KV: map_{id} Return JSON or 404 Cache-Control: no-cache
POST /api/cache --- 1. Verify Turnstile token (action + hostname check) 2. Size limit: 25 MiB 3. Skip KV write if exists 4. Put map_{id} to KV 5. Return { id, shortUrl }
KV: mesh_logger --- map_{hash} = graphData JSON parsed_graph = demo data Max 25 MiB per key
Turnstile Verification --- challenges.cloudflare.com action: turnstile-spin-v1 hostname whitelist: meshlog.camal.eu localhost / 127.0.0.1 mesh-log-mapper.xperia.workers.dev
HTMLRewriter --- Inject Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon.min.js on every HTML page
